title: Rabbi Elazar ben Taddai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A tanna of a baraita. He is mentioned in legal discussions in [Shabbat 123a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.123a.9), [Eruvin 71b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.71b.3), [Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shabbat.3.3.3) and [Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sotah.1.1.10). He appears after Rabbi Akiva in [Mekhilta DeRabbi Yishmael, Tractate Shirah 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Mekhilta_DeRabbi_Yishmael%2C_Tractate_Shirah.1.13-14). Hyman cites the [Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon 1](https://www.sefaria.org/Epistle_of_Rav_Sherira_Gaon.1.11-12) for placing him in the generation of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat and the Epistle give Elazar, while Eruvin and the Mekhilta give Eliezer. The Mekhilta’s passage records how Moses led the Song and Israel answered. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=519&lang=en) likewise cites the Epistle for the generation.
